_about: Customer personalities: built-in traits, what they change, and what customers say. Read by the mod (embedded resource) and TCG Studio (Customers page). A setup's customers\customers.json can replace the lines of any situation, and each customer can have own lines. Effects: money = max money ×, itemChance / cardChance = % added to the buy chance, talk = how often they speak ×, rip = chance to open bought packs in the shop, wish = cards on their wishlist (max 5), skill = table skill added, review = how much their mood moves reviews ×, mood = how much events change their mood ×, visit = how often they come ×, tip = tips ×, grudge = how fast table losses make a rival ×, steal = chance to try to walk out without paying (only with Shoplifting on), patience = seconds they wait in a till queue before giving up (0 = forever; added up). Trait fields: requires = only rolled while that module is on, weight = how often it is rolled (default 1). The base effects apply to everyone; traits add (itemChance, cardChance, rip, wish, skill) or multiply (the others).

guide.title: Customers
lines: Walk-ins have a name and up to two perks for one visit. Some become regulars when they leave, especially ones who spend well.
Regulars come back with the same name and look, and the shop remembers what they did.
Look at anyone, customer or employee, to see their panel on the right.
This board has all your regulars, under Regulars: rename them, nickname them, or remove them.
Perks are on their own tabs here. Set them for regulars you make yourself on the Customers page in TCG Studio.

guide.title: The panel
lines: Their panel shows only what applies to them, so the lines differ from person to person.
Patience: runs down only while they wait at a till or to trade. Loyalty: regulars only, see the Loyalty page.

Prized card: the most valuable card in their binder. Everyone carries a small binder, up to 10 cards. It changes when they pull something good from a pack here, trade with another customer, or sell you a card. When the binder is full, the least valuable card goes.

Skill: how good they are at the table, from 1 to 100. It decides who is likelier to win when two customers play each other, never better than 4 in 5. It doesn't change over time, and it doesn't affect games against you.
Tables: their wins and losses against other customers. Vs you: their wins and losses against you.
Opened packs: how many packs they have opened here, and their best pull.
Traded, ripped off: their trades with other customers, and who got the worse of them.
Friends and rival: who they get along with, and who they have it in for.
Caught stealing, got away, kicked out, gave up waiting: their record in your shop. Their latest review shows too.

guide.title: Loyalty
lines: Only regulars have loyalty. It is a record of your relationship: it changes how they greet you, not what they buy or how often they come.
It grows when they buy something, play your tournaments or you at a table, pull something big here or find a card they wanted.
It drops when they leave empty-handed, give up waiting, get caught stealing or get kicked out.
Tiers:

guide.title: Patience
lines: The patience bar only runs down while they wait at a till, or wait to trade with you.
When it runs out they leave. Unpaid things go back on the shelves, or into boxes on the floor if they do not fit.

guide.title: Trouble
lines: A thief shows in red with a warning at the top of the screen. Look at them and left click before they get out, and they go back to pay.
A thief who gets out takes the stock with them.
{kick} kicks out the customer you look at.
Kicking out someone stinky pleases the customers nearby. Kick out anyone else and they disapprove.
Regulars kicked out too often are banned and stop coming.

guide.title: Shop life
lines: Customers chat, gossip, trade from their binders and play at your tables by themselves.
Good pulls draw a crowd. Regulars who get along become friends. Losing too often, or being ripped off, makes rivals.
Regulars earn nicknames for what they do. Some titles have one holder, and someone with a better record can take it.

guide.title: Employees
lines: Employees you make in TCG Studio appear in the hire app next to the game's own, with the look, voice and perks you gave them.
Perks only work on employees you made. Every employee talks, unless you turn that off in the mod settings.
